summary: Verified Cognito OPERATOR (RoofSpan admin) login callback implementation on the Vercel serverless drop-in plus the CP proof endpoint. All 3 test suites pass exactly as expected and the live CP /operator/me endpoint returns 401 unauth and 200 {operator:true} with the dev admin header.

test_results.node_behavioral_suite: 7/7 pass (deploy/vercel/tests/operator_auth.test.mjs) - PKCE S256, state/code validation (CSRF, missing), exchangeCode PKCE body + no Authorization header for public client + generic error without leakage
test_results.pytest_static_security_suite: 7/7 pass (backend/tests/test_operator_auth_vercel.py) - callback route mapped to /operator/callback, HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookie usage, no localStorage/sessionStorage token storage, no COGNITO_CLIENT_SECRET in browser assets, exact production callback URL https://roofspan.io/operator/callback, id_token used as bearer to /api/control-plane/operator/me, safe callback errors
test_results.test_control_plane: 17/17 pass (backend/tests/test_control_plane.py) - new GET /operator/me did not break existing CP suite; _require_admin / operator_auth unchanged

security_properties_confirmed: No Cognito client secret shipped to browser (server-only exchange in deploy/vercel/api/operator/*.js)
No token stored in localStorage/sessionStorage (id_token stored in HttpOnly op_token cookie)
OAuth state validated (rejects missing + mismatched -> CSRF protection)
Server-side PKCE code_verifier -> /oauth2/token; public client (no Authorization header)
Production callback URL is exactly https://roofspan.io/operator/callback
id_token used as Bearer to CP /api/control-plane/operator/me
operator_auth.py NOT weakened; new /operator/me only adds a read-only guarded endpoint
critical_code_review_comments: Implementation cleanly isolates the Cognito PKCE exchange to Vercel serverless functions; browser never sees the client secret and never touches raw tokens.
CP change is minimally invasive: single new GET /operator/me guarded by existing _require_admin - no changes to operator_auth.py JWT validation surface.
Node behavioral tests cover both happy path and negative paths (CSRF, missing code, upstream failure without leakage) - good coverage for the auth boundary.
Static-string pytest suite is a reasonable belt-and-suspenders check to prevent regressions that leak secrets to the browser or move tokens to localStorage.
test_credentials: Dev CP admin header: X-RoofSpan-Admin = value of control_plane.config.DEV_ADMIN_SECRET (retrieved dynamically in test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Cognito Hosted UI + live Vercel deployment on roofspan.io cannot be exercised from this pod - that requires a human with real pool/client/domain. All local verifiable properties (behavioral, static security, CP endpoint) are green. If the CP dies again, restore per env note (chown/chmod /data/db/roofspan_pgdata then start supervisord).
